answer.reason: The verses say Ono was built by sons of Elpaal, which goes beyond the summary, while the other verses only list it or name it as a meeting place that was never used.

clauses.english: was built, with Lod and its towns, by sons of Elpaal
clauses.quote: who built Ono, and Lod, with the towns thereof

doubts: 1CH 8:12 does not make clear whether Shamed alone or all three sons built Ono, so the clause says only 'sons of Elpaal'.
NEH 6:2 only names the plain of Ono as a proposed meeting place that Nehemiah never went to, so it is left out.
EZR 2:33 and NEH 7:37 only list the returning families of Lod, Hadid and Ono, so they are left out.
